question: How long did the US federal government shutdown that began on October 1, 2025 last, and how did it end?
text:
The U.S. federal government shutdown lasted **43 calendar days**, from **October 1 through November 12, 2025**, counting the day it ended. The Congressional Research Service counts **42 full days** of lapsed funding, through November 11. ([oig.dol.gov](https://oig.dol.gov/public/oifindings/50-26-004-01-001.pdf?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=openai))

It ended on the evening of **November 12**, when President Donald Trump signed **H.R. 5371** into law. The Senate had approved the funding package **60–40** on November 10, and the House passed it **222–209** on November 12. The law restored funding for most of the government through **January 30, 2026**, and provided full-year funding for three of the twelve regular appropriations bills. ([clickorlando.com](https://www.clickorlando.com/business/2025/11/12/house-returns-for-vote-to-end-the-government-shutdown-after-nearly-2-months-away/?utm_source=openai))
